about.title: Bɔt Nexir
about.p1: Nexir na wan AI-pawa brand neming studio we dɛn bil fɔ di wan dɛn we mek am, di wan dɛn we mek am, ɛn di tim dɛn. We yu jɔyn intɛligent ki wɔd analisis wit rial-taym domɛyn avaylabl, Nexir de ɛp yu fɔ fɛn difrɛn, brand-rɛdi nem dɛn fast fast—so yu kin muv frɔm aydia to aydentiti wit kɔnfidɛns.
about.v1: Clarity: Nexir de pe atɛnshɔn pan rilevans, mɛmba, ɛn intent—nɔto ɛndlɛs, jenɛrik opshɔn.
about.v2: Originality: Fresh aidia dɛn we nɔ de saund random.
about.v3: Spid: Gret opshɔn dɛn insay sɛkɔn, nɔto dez.
about.ceoQuote: Nexir na fɔ gi pawa to bilda dɛn na ɛvri stej wit intɛligent nem tul dɛn we de chenj aydia dɛn to klia, kredibul, ɛn ɔnabl brand dɛn—we nɔ gɛt frikshɔn, gɛs wok, ɔ west tɛm.
about.missionBody: Fɔ ɛp di faunda dɛn fɔ tɔn aydia dɛn to klia, kredibul, ɛn ɔnaable brand aydentiti—fast.
about.visionBody: Fɔ bi di AI nem kɔmpin we dɛn kin trɔst pas ɔl fɔ bilda dɛn ɔlsay na di wɔl.

privacy.title: Praivasi Polici
privacy.s1Body: Nexir ("wi", "aw") de rispek yu praivasi. Dis polici de tel ow infomeshon de wok wen yu de yus nexir.io, wan AI brand-nɛm platform. Nexir mek fɔ wok witaot akaunt ɔ pesin infomeshon.
privacy.s2Title: 2. Infomeshon we wi no de kolek
privacy.s2Body: Nexir no de kolek, kip, ɔ proses pesin infomeshon lek nɛm, imel, fon nɔmba, yusa akaunt/profail, ɔ peyin infomeshon. Yu fit yus Nexir witaot regista ɔ tel wi u yu bi.
privacy.s3Body: Yu fit put keywords fɔ mek brand nɛm. Di keywords de yus ɔnli fɔ mek risɔlt na di taim we yu aks, wi no de kip am, en wi no de tay am to yu; afta di wok, e don.
privacy.s4Body: If yu yus di “Save” fɔshɔn, di nɛm dem de kip na yu brouza ɔnli. Nexir no get aksɛs to dat data en e no de go na wi sava. If yu klia yu brouza data, di sev nɛm dem go los.
privacy.s5Body: Nexir no de yus trak kuki ɔ ad kuki. Wi fit yus nomo smɔl teknikal storage we nɛd fɔ di basik fɔshɔn.
privacy.s6Body: Nexir de yus Google Analytics fɔ kolek anɔnim stɛtistik fɔ mek di service beta. E fit kolek wich pej yu visit, apɔksimet lokeshɔn (kɔntri/ridjɔn), divais en brouza tayp, weh yu kam frɔm, en aw long yu tin na pej.
privacy.s6IpBody: Nexir don set IP anɔnim, we mek IP adrès de shɔt bifɔ dem kip am, so dem no fit yus am fɔ idɛntifai pesin.
privacy.s6UseTitle: Aw wi de yus di data
privacy.s6UseBody: Wi de yus Analytics data ɔnli fɔ andastand aw pipul de yus di saet en fɔ impruv perfɔmɛns en fɔshɔn. Nexir no de idɛntifai wan wan yusa, no de trak yusa na oda saet, en no de sel pesin data.
privacy.s7Body: Nexir fit get afiliɛt link dem (lek domain registra). Dis link dem no de mek yu pay mɔ. Oda servis dem get den ɔn praivasi polisi.
privacy.s8Body: Nexir nɔto fɔ pikin we no rich 13, en wi no de kolek den data kɔndɔli.
privacy.s9Body: Bikos Nexir no de kolek pesin data, wi no get pesin data na wi sava. Yu de kɔntrol eni tin we de kip lɔkɔl na yu brouza.
privacy.s10Body: Wi fit apdet dis polici as Nexir de gro. Wi go put apdet dem na dis pej.
privacy.s11Body: If yu get kueshɔn bɔt dis polici, kontak wi na hello@nexir.io.
